Although primitive, the Talz are quick learners and take to technology quite well. Their two sets of distinctive eyes allow them to see at all times- one set works in bright light, the other in total darkness. Their thick fur is suited to the frigid temperatures of
Talz are gentle, kind-hearted, and slow to anger.

A Talz is completely covered in shaggy white fur. Each one has four black eyes, plus a proboscis for talking and eating, and two large hands with sharp talons. A typical Talz stands 2.0 meters tall and weighs 90 kilograms.
